name: AFTER SCHOOL
source:
AFTER SCHOOL is a coming-of-age story about detention, baseball, gangs and friendship. Join Ellis in his chaotic adventures as he meets others both cute and terrible! Then maybe —  finally make a friend?

[From [url=https://feverfiction.itch.io/afterschool]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《放学后》是一个关于拘留、棒球、帮派和友谊的成长故事。与埃利斯一起经历混乱的冒险，因为他会遇到可爱和可怕的其他人！那么也许——终于交到朋友了？

[来自[url=https://feverfiction.itch.io/afterschool]itch.io[/url]]
